entry.title: v16.14 in development: sweepers with memory and gnulte --compare
entry.summary: Work in progress on main: sweepers that remember what they have seen, and a --compare mode that diffs two report JSON snapshots, optionally as an HTML comparison report. Unreleased.

entry.title: GNULTE v16.13 released — watch history and a machine feed
entry.summary: The LAN watch now remembers: a JSONL timeline of every debounced up/down transition, a --json JSON-lines event feed with alerts on stderr, -alert-debounce hysteresis, screen 6 history, and an HTML report with a 7-day latency trend and a 0-100 health score per host.

entry.title: GNULTE v16.12 released — scenarios, per-target shaping, profiles and a session summary
entry.summary: --scenario plays timed phases with optional sine/sawtooth wobble and loss bursts; --per-target gives individual hosts their own netem class; --profile save:NAME stores presets; and a finished run rolls up min/avg/p95/max, jitter, loss distribution and an E-model MOS into the console and the HTML report.

entry.title: GNULTE v16.11 released — gnulte-top, the live bandwidth top
entry.summary: A live per-host and per-conversation bandwidth view built on the same in-process AF_PACKET counter the LAN watch uses: ranked top talkers with down/up rates, peer counts and bars, plus --flows, --csv and --json.

entry.title: GNULTE v16.9 and v16.10 released — gnulte-doctor and gnulte-trace
entry.summary: gnulte-doctor is a zero-dependency pre-flight check (PASS/WARN/FAIL with fix-it hints, --json, non-zero exit on failure). gnulte-trace is an mtr-style hop-by-hop path probe with in-process ICMP echo at every TTL, per-hop last/avg/best/worst and loss, --json and an HTML report — no traceroute(8) behind it.

entry.title: The Unplugged series, v16.6 to v16.8 — arping, arp-scan, ping, tcpdump and their friends are gone
entry.summary: The v17 Unplugged programme ships in increments: ARP sweeps are crafted in-process over AF_PACKET (16.6), ICMP echo is built and matched on a raw socket (16.7), and pcap capture comes from AF_PACKET through a standard-library libpcap writer (16.8). The toolkit now runs on a bare box with nothing but the kernel and tc/iptables.

entry.title: GNULTE v16.0 "Steady Hands" and v15.0 "Live Interconnection"
entry.summary: v15 wired the tools together through one shared device store; v16 filed the sharp edges off: clean Ctrl+C teardown, interruptible name-identification waits, honest sampling cadence, fixed arrow-key repeat in the LAN watch, --note labels and gnulte-scan --watch N --json.
